purpose: Teach: 棺/鱗/葡萄/シルクロード/ラベンダー/眼科/苗字/ピストル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会の授業で棺の歴史やったろ?
lines.en: Hey, Riku — you studied the history of coffins in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, testing tone. A setup — she's building toward something. Casual lean, slight playfulness in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科で魚の鱗を取る練習したろ?桜
lines.en: You practiced scaling fish in home ec, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quick return volley, equally light. He's caught on to the game. Steady, unflustered, matching her rhythm note for note.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、葡萄ジュース好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku — your family likes grape juice, right?
lines.style: Pressing in slightly. The questions are getting stranger, more personal. She's still smiling but there's focus underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でシルクロードのレポート書いたろ?桜
lines.en: You wrote a report on the Silk Road in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Patient but deliberate. He's not confused — he knows exactly what she's doing. Slight edge of quiet amusement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の家、ラベンダーの香り好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku — your family likes the smell of lavender, right?
lines.style: Narrowing down. Softer now, more intent. She's getting at something very specific. The playfulness is still there but underneath is real purpose.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、眼科でメガネ作ったろ?桜
lines.en: You got your glasses made at the eye doctor, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Same patient rhythm. He's not rushed, not defensive. He knows where this is going and he's letting her get there.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の苗字、いつ書いても間違えられるよな
lines.en: Riku — no matter how many times you write your last name, people always get it wrong, don't they?
lines.style: Land it quietly. Not quite a question anymore — a statement with a wry upturn. She's found the center. No rush, just acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、博物館で古いピストル見たろ?桜
lines.en: You saw an old pistol at the museum, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Small, genuine exhale underneath. He gets it now. His voice is closer, smaller — the game is over and something real just happened.
